name: passive-invoice-audit
description: Exception-focused audit of passive FatturaPA invoices against booked ledger entries, with deterministic checks and native Codex/Luna semantic review.

interface.shortDescription: Screen booked passive invoices and surface only review exceptions.
interface.longDescription: Vera workflow for read-only full-population review of Italian passive invoices already booked in accounting. Deterministic code extracts structured FatturaPA evidence, matches ledger movements without forcing uncertainty, checks arithmetic and accounting mechanics, and persists a restartable audit trail. Compact matched-invoice packets are reviewed only by gpt-5.6-luna through the native Codex client and its existing authenticated session; scripts make no direct model API calls and require no API key. The primary XLSX workpaper contains exceptions, while machine-readable JSONL retains one record per invoice.
defaultPrompt: Audit these passive FatturaPA invoices against the actual ledger entries and prepare an exception workpaper.
Keep all accounting sources read-only, use deterministic checks first, and use only gpt-5.6-luna through native Codex for semantic review.
Treat no_issue_detected as screening language, never as proof that a booking is correct.
